sourcePolicy.scope: Second pass over all 35 ASOS place refs classified P1 by global reconciliation but absent from current .40 place layers, after integration of the earlier 25-card place delta.

summary.recommendation: Do not add new place cards from this remaining set. Each candidate is an alias, generic/temporary/interior setting, unnamed locale, or unresolved sublocation. Reclassify priorities and preserve useful scene detail in existing parent cards, routes, events, or encounter notes.

reviewedCandidates.name: Bracken inn
reviewedCandidates.recommendation: P3; retain as a travel-scene detail only
reviewedCandidates.reason: Chapter 1 describes a burned inn in House Bracken lands; the index label is descriptive, not a proper place name.
